subject: english
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Significant** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Significant **means important or meaningful. (महत्वपूर्ण या सार्थक) • **Example**: The discovery of a new treatment for a previously incurable disease is a significant breakthrough in medical research. • In this context, the blank needs a word that fits the meaning of the sentence. • The sentence implies that the answer being chosen is important or meaningful. Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Insignificant **means not important or not worth considering. (महत्वपूर्ण नहीं है या विचार करने लायक नहीं है) • **Meaningless **means having no meaning or significance. (जिसका कोई अर्थ या महत्त्व न हो) • **Demonstrative **means serving to demonstrate or prove something. (कुछ प्रदर्शित करने या साबित करने की सेवा करना) 43:T90f, The correct answer is: **Governed**
